note: achats auprès d'Ablecom et de Compuware en pourcentage du coût des ventes (10-Q 2023-12-31) : montants relevés dans la note des parties liées ; clients et fournisseurs significatifs désignés par lettre
quote: Purchases from Ablecom, and Compuware, related parties of the Company (see Part I, Item 1, Note 8, "Related Party Transactions") accounted for a combined 3.6% and 6.7% of total cost of sales for the three months ended December 31, 2023 and 2022, respectively, and a combined 4.6% and 6.6% of total cost of sales for the six months ended December 31, 2023 and 2022, respectively.
